components.name: Text Field
components.description: Visible label above, help text in muted, 44px control with a visible edge, no placeholder.
components.html: As it appears on invitations.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #211f1c; } .ds-field label { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font: 400 16px/1.5 inherit; background: #ffffff; color: #211f1c; border: 1px solid #857e72; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: 2px solid #222a5e; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field p { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #5a554d; }

components.name: Rail with Paper Tab
components.description: The signature: the current destination is a tab of paper joined to the page, on the ink rail.
components.html: SettingsDashboard
components.css: .ds-shell { display: flex; height: 160px; background: #f6f4ef; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-rail { width: 200px; background: #222a5e; padding: 16px 16px 16px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; overflow-x: hidden; } .ds-item { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #f3f2fb; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-item:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f3f2fb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-current { background: #f6f4ef; color: #211f1c; font-weight: 600; width: calc(100% + 16px); margin-right: -16px; border-top-right-radius: 0; border-bottom-right-radius: 0; } .ds-current:hover { background: #f6f4ef; } .ds-page { flex: 1; }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: A white surface on paper: 1px warm border, 12px corners, flat. Never on auth screens.

narrative.overview:
Abonemen looks like a paper binder with an ink spine. A deep ink-blue rail carries the mark, the household and the destinations; the pages beside it are warm paper with white surfaces laid on them. It is calm on purpose: the product's job is to say what renews next and what needs action, then let the person close it. It refuses the finance-dashboard look (navy and gold, hero numbers, glossy charts) and the default grey app with one blue button.

The system is flat and quiet. Corners are 10px, borders are 1px warm greys, nothing casts a shadow except menus and dialogs. Type is Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, chosen so that look-alike characters cannot be confused, because a child, an older relative and a person with low vision use this as much as the parent who runs the money. Red, green and amber appear only to mean something, and always with an icon and words.

The light and dark themes share one set of colour roles; a third (high contrast) is reserved for a later ticket.
keyCharacteristics: Ink rail beside paper page, joined by a tab for the current destination.
One ink blue, doing two jobs: the rail field and the accent. Periwinkle replaces it in dark.
Warm greys throughout, including every colour Flux paints from its zinc scale.
Flat surfaces; shadow only on overlays.
16px body, 14px smallest, 44px controls on every device.

rules.name: The Meaning-Only Rule
rules.body: Red, green and amber say something happened or needs doing. They are never decoration, and never alone: an icon and words go with them.

rules.name: The Roles-Not-Palette Rule
rules.body: A view says `text-danger` or `bg-surface`, never `text-red-500` or `bg-white`. `ColourUsageTest` fails the raw palette colours.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: The same ink blue is the rail and the accent. Do not add a second accent hue.

rules.name: The Sixteen-Fourteen Rule
rules.body: 16px is the body and every control's text; 14px is the floor. `text-xs` never appears; `ColourUsageTest` refuses it.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Money and dates use tabular figures so columns line up. Money is always amount, currency code and period together.

rules.name: The Flat-Paper Rule
rules.body: A panel on the page has a border and no shadow. A shadow means "this floats above the page".

dos: Do use colour roles (`bg-paper`, `bg-surface`, `text-ink`, `text-muted`, `text-accent`, `text-danger`, `text-success`, `text-warning`) for every colour.
Do open every app page with the page header: one h1, one line of description, the primary action at the right.
Do set `--mark-knock` to the colour behind the mark wherever it is placed.
Do keep every control 44px tall and every text at 16px, with 14px as the floor.
Do show a confirmation in the status message component, in the page, with an icon and text.
Do pair every danger, success or warning with an icon and words.
Do put money and dates in tabular figures, with amount, currency code and period together.
Do let surfaces be a white panel with a 1px warm border and no shadow.
donts: Don't put eyebrow labels, kickers or small-caps overlines above headings.
Don't put cards or panels around auth screens; the form sits on the paper.
Don't use raw palette colours (`text-red-500`, `text-green-600`, `text-zinc-400`) for state or text.
Don't use `text-xs` or any text under 14px.
Don't use toasts; they vanish on a timer and a screen reader never hears them.
Don't add shadows to panels, or a second accent hue, or navy-and-gold finance styling with hero numbers.
Don't replace the slashed zero or switch the typeface to a system display face.
Don't show colour alone as meaning: the current page, an error and a confirmation each have a second cue.
Don't use placeholders as labels, or `label:sr-only`.
